name: Kosaka (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Kosaka town emblem in white: an outlined disc with a scalloped edge enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Kosaka, a town in Akita Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1972.

features.role: Kosaka town emblem — an outlined disc with a scalloped edge enclosing a stylised character
